m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (references/global-crew.md, references/global-everyone.md), then project deltas docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md and docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, then the handoff at .agent-work/issue-456/crew-handoffs/g0-implement.md and the reference prototype. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format); if incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff + prototype loaded; handoff complete
postconditions.satisfied_by: Read global-crew.md, global-everyone.md, docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the g0 handoff, gate-spec.json g0, DESIGN_SPEC storage section, and all seven prototype modules. Handoff verified complete: task, protected intent, test mode, close criteria, allowed scope, specific exclusions, constraints, map anchors, required evidence, wiring grep, verification commands, authority, stop conditions and return format are all present.

m1-discovery.title: Discovery layer: enumerate the mappable corpus, .agent-work/ excluded (TDD)
m1-discovery.imperative: TDD REQUIRED. Write tests/test_code_map.py first with discovery tests that fail: discover_corpus() returns tracked *.py paths from git ls-files with .agent-work/ excluded, and a test that goes red if the exclusion is removed. Observe them failing (attest c1), then create scripts/code_map/__init__.py and scripts/code_map/discovery.py to make them green. Stdlib only. Do not pin the literal corpus count -- assert the exclusion rule.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: discovery tests written and observed failing before the module exists
postconditions.satisfied_by: Two reds observed. (1) Tests written before the module: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts.code_map'. (2) Behavioral red: discovery.py implemented with EXCLUDED_PREFIXES = () -- '2 failed, 3 passed', AssertionError listing 141 .agent-work paths leaking into the corpus. Adding the exclusion turned it green: 5 passed.

constraints: stdlib only
no defect fixes
no schema changes
assert the exclusion rule, never a pinned corpus count

m2-cli.title: argparse CLI: build_parser and main (TDD)
m2-cli.imperative: TDD REQUIRED. Write the CLI argument-handling tests first and observe them failing (attest c1): build_parser() accepts the stage subcommands, --root defaults to the repo root, an unknown subcommand exits 2. Then add scripts/code_map/cli.py and scripts/code_map/__main__.py to make them green. The discover subcommand must call discover_corpus so the discovery layer has a real external caller.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: CLI argument-handling tests written and observed failing before cli.py exists
postconditions.satisfied_by: TDD red observed before cli.py existed: 'ImportError: cannot import name cli from scripts.code_map', 1 error during collection. After adding cli.py and __main__.py: 7 passed, 6 subtests passed.

postconditions.statement: CLI tests green and `python -m scripts.code_map discover` exits 0

check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_code_map.py -k cli -q --color=no && python -m scripts.code_map discover --root . > /dev/null

constraints: stdlib only
argparse only -- no third-party CLI library

m3-extract.title: Port the extract stage (astx.py) behind the CLI
m3-extract.imperative: Test-after allowed. Port .agent-work/issue-456/reference/prototype/astx.py to scripts/code_map/extract.py: replace the hardcoded f1Brainz ROOT and INDEX_DIRS with the discovered mappable corpus, and replace the slice_manifest.json dependency with discover_corpus(). Port the extraction logic verbatim -- do NOT fix D1/D2/D3 and do NOT change the statement schema. Drop the timing fields from the run report. Wire it to the CLI extract subcommand.

postconditions.statement: the extract stage runs over this repo and writes a non-empty statement store

constraints: stdlib only
no defect fixes
no schema changes
the run report carries no timings

m4-supplement.title: Port the supplement stage behind the CLI
m4-supplement.imperative: Test-after allowed. Port .agent-work/issue-456/reference/prototype/supplement.py to scripts/code_map/supplement.py, root-parameterized and driven by discover_corpus(). Port it, do not improve it -- gate g3 removes this stage entirely. Drop the timing fields from the run report. Wire it to the CLI supplement subcommand.

postconditions.statement: the supplement stage runs over this repo and writes a non-empty supplement

constraints: stdlib only
port it, do not improve it
the run report carries no timings

m5-render.title: Port the render stage and close the end-to-end build
m5-render.imperative: Test-after allowed. Port .agent-work/issue-456/reference/prototype/render_map.py to scripts/code_map/render.py, moving its import-time store loading into a function so importing the module has no side effects. Root-parameterized; title the top index from the repo. Drop the timing fields from the run report. Wire the render subcommand and a build subcommand that runs extract -> supplement -> render end to end and exits 0.

postconditions.statement: the CLI runs extract -> render end to end on this repo, exits 0, and produces the page tree

check.command: python -m scripts.code_map build --root . && test -f map/INDEX.md && test -f map/ids.jsonl

constraints: stdlib only
no defect fixes
no schema changes
the run report carries no timings
do NOT commit the map/ page tree -- it is staged at gs

m6-checks.title: Port the print-only diagnostics only as far as keeping the CLI wired
m6-checks.imperative: Port checks.py and checks2.py to scripts/code_map/checks.py as one module, only as far as keeping the CLI wired. They are print-only -- no assertions, no exit code -- and gate g1 REWRITES them; do not start that rewrite. Drop the sections whose target is a hardcoded f1Brainz file that does not exist in this repo, and say so in the module docstring. Wire the check subcommand.

postconditions.statement: the check subcommand runs against this repo's stores and exits 0

constraints: stdlib only
do NOT rewrite the checks -- that is g1
print-only, no assertions, no exit code

m7-gitignore-bundling.title: .gitignore narrow entries and the bundling question resolved on the record
m7-gitignore-bundling.imperative: Add three narrow, explicit .gitignore entries -- one each for the statement store, the supplement and the position cache. No blanket scratch rule: .agent-work/ is deliberately TRACKED here. Then resolve the bundling question: scripts/install_constellation.py keeps the install destination FLAT, so a multi-module package with intra-package imports cannot survive bundling. Add the declaration and a guard test that every Python package under scripts/ is declared either installable or non-installable, and that no skill bundle names a module inside a non-installable package. Record the resolution as a written statement in the result.

preconditions.statement: the package exists and the pipeline runs

postconditions.statement: the bundling guard test passes and the deliverable paths are not ignored

check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_install_constellation.py -q --color=no && ! git check-ignore -q scripts/code_map/__init__.py tests/test_code_map.py .gitignore

constraints: .gitignore entries must be narrow and explicit -- one each, no blanket rule
touch nothing else in install_constellation.py or its test

m8-falsifiable.title: Prove the exclusion test can go red
m8-falsifiable.imperative: Load-bearing evidence. Delete the .agent-work/ exclusion from the discovery layer, run the discovery tests and capture the RED output, assert the mutation actually applied, then restore the exclusion and capture the GREEN output. Paste both runs in the result. Attest c1 with the red run; c2 re-runs green.

preconditions.statement: discovery layer and its tests are in place

postconditions.statement: the exclusion test observed RED with the exclusion removed, with the mutation confirmed applied
the exclusion test green with the exclusion restored

constraints: a check that cannot fail is indistinguishable from one that passed
assert the mutation actually applied

m9-close.title: Full suite green, wiring grep, result artifact, local commit
m9-close.imperative: Run the full suite and derive any failure distribution mechanically with --color=no. Run the wiring grep naming every symbol this slice adds, each with a call site outside its own definition, and state the count of external call sites. Re-derive the mappable-corpus number and record what you got. Write the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/issue-456/crew-handoffs/g0-implement-RESULT.md, commit locally (no push, no PR, no merge), and send the verdict to the commander.

postconditions.statement: the full suite is green at this gate boundary
every new symbol has at least one call site outside its own definition

check.command: grep -rn 'discover_corpus\|build_parser' --include=*.py scripts/code_map/ tests/test_code_map.py | grep -v 'def discover_corpus' | grep -v 'def build_parser' | grep -q .

constraints: do not push, do not open a PR, do not merge to main
do not commit the map/ page tree
